unknown_mpp_physical.message: physical area weighting requires both recorded MPP axes

patient_level0_area_is_not_physical.message: patient weights must be equal or physical area; statistics explicit

broadcast_patient_probabilities.message: local overlays require actual tile-level scores

out_of_canvas_without_clip.message: tile valid rectangle outside canvas; request explicit clipping

negative_summary_weight.message: weights must match values and be finite nonnegative

numerical_contract.weighted_quantiles: inverted CDF, stable(value,id)sort, total and prefix sequential_f64 in identical sorted order; first prefix>=q*total; no threshold epsilon
numerical_contract.patient_default: Equal weight of accepted slides, after tile-to-slide summary; never pool all patient tiles by default.
numerical_contract.empty: Missing remains missing, with count0/weight0 and explicit no_accepted status. Zero-tile slides retain supplied slide_patients mapping.
numerical_contract.raster: Actual accepted tile scores, center sampling of half-open valid rectangles, overlap arithmetic mean; missing value NaN and alpha0; coverage exact u64.
numerical_contract.raster_block_centers: Always original_canvas_origin+(global_pixel_index+.5)*pixel_size, never subcanvas re-association. Reference may slice whole oracle; native must compute lazy blocks without allocating whole canvas.
numerical_contract.hue: Generic numeric aggregation does not reinterpret circular angles; automatic H feature production excludes raw mean_degrees from ordinary modeling/aggregation.
